'JWT' : 'Legacy'})`\n            });\n            \n            // Emitir evento de logout antes de limpiar la sesión\n            eventBus.emit(EVENT_NAMES.USER_LOGOUT, { user: usuario, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n        }\n        \n        // Logout según el sistema activo\n        if (authModel.isJWTEnabled()) {\n            authModel.logoutJWT();\n        } else {\n            authModel.logout();\n        }\n        \n        // Emitir evento de limpieza de página\n        eventBus.emit(EVENT_NAMES.PAGE_UNLOAD, { reason: 'logout' });\n        \n        AuthGuard.redirectToLogin();\n    }\n\n    static getCurrentUserRole() {\n        let usuario;\n        if (authModel.isJWTEnabled()) {\n            usuario = authModel.getCurrentUserFromJWT();\n        } else {\n            usuario = authModel.getCurrentUser();\n        }\n        return usuario ? 'JWT' : 'legacy'} validada exitosamente`);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    static hasPermission(requiredRoles) {\n        let usuario;\n        if (authModel.isJWTEnabled()) {\n            usuario = authModel.getCurrentUserFromJWT();\n        } else {\n            usuario = authModel.getCurrentUser();\n        }\n        \n        if (!usuario) return false;\n        \n        return Array.isArray(requiredRoles) ? \n            requiredRoles.includes(usuario.rol) : \n            usuario.rol === requiredRoles;\n    }\n\n    static requirePermission(requiredRoles, errorMessage = 'No tienes permisos para realizar esta acción.') {\n        if (!AuthGuard.hasPermission(requiredRoles)) {\n            alert(errorMessage);\n            console.error(`AuthGuard: Acceso denegado. startTime);\n            return result;\n        } catch (error) {\n            const endTime = performance.now();\n            this.recordMetric(name, endTime - startTime, { error: true });\n            throw error;\n        }\n    }\n\n    startTimer(name) {\n        this.startTimes[name] = performance.now();\n    }\n\n    endTimer(name) {\n        if (this.startTimes[name]) {\n            const duration = performance.now() - this.startTimes[name];\n            this.recordMetric(name, duration);\n            delete this.startTimes[name];\n            return duration;\n        }\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    recordMetric(name, value, metadata = {}) {\n        if (!this.metrics[name]) {\n            this.metrics[name] = {\n                count: 0,\n                total: 0,\n                average: 0,\n                min: Infinity,\n                max: -Infinity,\n                errors: 0\n            };\n        }\n\n        const metric = this.metrics[name];\n        metric.count++;\n        metric.total += value;\n        metric.average = metric.total / metric.count;\n        metric.min = Math.min(metric.min, value);\n        metric.max = Math.max(metric.max, value);\n\n        if (metadata.error) {\n            metric.errors++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    getMetrics(name = null) {\n        if (name) {\n            return this.metrics[name] || null;\n        }\n        return { ...this.metrics };\n    }\n\n    clearMetrics() {\n        this.metrics = {};\n        this.startTimes = {};\n    }\n\n    logMetrics() {\n        console.log('Performance Metrics:', this.metrics);\n    }\n}\n\nconst performanceMonitor = new PerformanceMonitor();\nexport default performanceMonitor;"

            "text": "// js/utils/eventBus.js\n// Event Bus pattern implementation for decoupling components\n\nclass EventBus {\n    constructor() {\n        this.events = {};\n        this.debug = true; // Set to false in production\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Subscribe to an event\n     * @param {string} event - Event name\n     * @param {Function} callback - Callback function\n     * @param {Object} context - Context for the callback (optional)\n     * @returns {Function} - Unsubscribe function\n     */\n    on(event, callback, context = null) {\n        if (typeof callback !== 'function') {\n            console.error('EventBus: Callback must be a function');\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (!this.events[event]) {\n            this.events[event] = [];\n        }\n\n        const listener = {\n            callback,\n            context,\n            id: Date.now() + Math.random()\n        };\n\n        this.events[event].push(listener);\n\n        if (this.debug) {\n            console.log(`EventBus: Subscribed to '${event}' (ID: ${listener.id})`);\n        }\n\n        // Return unsubscribe function\n        return () => this.off(event, listener.id);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Subscribe to an event only once\n     * @param {string} event - Event name\n     * @param {Function} callback - Callback function\n     * @param {Object} context - Context for the callback (optional)\n     * @returns {Function} - Unsubscribe function\n     */\n    once(event, callback, context = null) {\n        const unsubscribe = this.on(event, (...args) => {\n            unsubscribe();\n            callback.apply(context, args);\n        }, context);\n\n        return unsubscribe;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Unsubscribe from an event\n     * @param {string} event - Event name\n     * @param {string|number} listenerId - Listener ID (optional, removes all if not provided)\n     */\n    off(event, listenerId = null) {\n        if (!this.events[event]) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (listenerId) {\n            this.events[event] = this.events[event].filter(listener => listener.id !== listenerId);\n            if (this.debug) {\n                console.log(`EventBus: Unsubscribed from '${event}' (ID: ${listenerId})`);\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Remove all listeners for this event\n            const count = this.events[event].length;\n            this.events[event] = [];\n            if (this.debug) {\n                console.log(`EventBus: Removed all ${count} listeners for '${event}'`);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Clean up empty event arrays\n        if (this.events[event].length === 0) {\n            delete this.events[event];\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Emit an event\n     * @param {string} event - Event name\n     * @param {...any} args - Arguments to pass to callbacks\n     * @returns {number} - Number of listeners called\n     */\n    emit(event, ...args) {\n        if (!this.events[event] || this.events[event].length === 0) {\n            if (this.debug) {\n                console.log(`EventBus: No listeners for event '${event}'`);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        const listeners = [...this.events[event]]; // Create a copy to avoid issues with modifications during iteration\n        let calledCount = 0;\n\n        if (this.debug) {\n            console.log(`EventBus: Emitting '${event}' to ${listeners.length} listeners`, args);\n        }\n\n        listeners.forEach(listener => {\n            try {\n                if (listener.context) {\n                    listener.callback.apply(listener.context, args);\n                } else {\n                    listener.callback(...args);\n                }\n                calledCount++;\n            } catch (error) {\n                console.error(`EventBus: Error in listener for '${event}':`, error);\n            }\n        });\n\n        return calledCount;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get all registered events\n     * @returns {Array} - Array of event names\n     */\n    getEvents() {\n        return Object.keys(this.events);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get listener count for an event\n     * @param {string} event - Event name\n     * @returns {number} - Number of listeners\n     */\n    getListenerCount(event) {\n        return this.events[event] ? this.events[event].length : 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Clear all events and listeners\n     */\n    clear() {\n        const eventCount = Object.keys(this.events).length;\n        this.events = {};\n        \n        if (this.debug) {\n            console.log(`EventBus: Cleared all events (${eventCount} events removed)`);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Enable or disable debug logging\n     * @param {boolean} enabled - Whether to enable debug logging\n     */\n    setDebug(enabled) {\n        this.debug = enabled;\n        console.log(`EventBus: Debug logging ${enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}`);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Get debug information about current state\n     * @returns {Object} - Debug information\n     */\n    getDebugInfo() {\n        const info = {\n            eventCount: Object.keys(this.events).length,\n            events: {}\n        };\n\n        Object.keys(this.events).forEach(event => {\n            info.events[event] = {\n                listenerCount: this.events[event].length,\n                listeners: this.events[event].map(l => ({\n                    id: l.id,\n                    hasContext: !!l.context\n                }))\n            };\n        });\n\n        return info;\n    }\n}\n\n// Create and export singleton instance\nconst eventBus = new EventBus();\n\n// Define standard event names to prevent typos\nexport Data events\n    DATA_LOADED: 'data:loaded',\n    DATA_SAVED: 'data:saved',\n    DATA_DELETED: 'data:deleted',\n    DATA_ERROR: 'data:error',\n\n    // UI events\n    SIDEBAR_TOGGLE: USER_DISPLAY_UPDATED: 'ui:user:display:updated',\n    USER_DROPDOWN_TOGGLED: 'ui:user:dropdown:toggled',\n\n    // Specific module events\n    PACIENTE_CREATED: 'paciente:created',\n    });\n  }\n}\n\n// Funciones auxiliares para gráficos\n\nfunction generarGraficoActividad(datosActividad) {\n  // Si no hay datos, mostrar mensaje\n  if (!datosActividad || Object.keys(datosActividad).length === 0) {\n    return '<div class=\"alert-info\">No hay datos suficientes para generar el gráfico.</div>';\n  }\n  \n  const labels = [];\n  const values = [];\n  const maxValue = Math.max(...Object.values(datosActividad), 1);\n  \n  // Ordenar fechas\n  const sortedDates = Object.keys(datosActividad).sort();\n  \n  for (const fecha of sortedDates) {\n    const value = datosActividad[fecha];\n    const fechaFormateada = formatearFecha(fecha);\n    labels.push(fechaFormateada);\n    values.push(value);\n  }\n  \n  let html = '<div class=\"chart-container\">';\n  \n  // Crear etiquetas de ejes\n  html += '<div class=\"chart-y-axis\">';\n  for (let i = maxValue; i >= 0; i -= Math.ceil(maxValue / 5)) {\n    html += `<div class=\"chart-y-label\">${i}</div>`;\n  }\n  html += '</div>';\n  \n  // Crear gráfico de barras\n  html += '<div class=\"chart-bars\">';\n  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {\n    const heightPercentage = (values[i] / maxValue) * 100;\n    html += `\n      <div class=\"chart-bar-column\">\n        <div class=\"chart-bar-tooltip\">${values[i]} acciones</div>\n        <div class=\"chart-bar\" style=\"height: ${heightPercentage}%\"></div>\n        <div class=\"chart-x-label\">${labels[i]}</div>\n      </div>\n    `;\n  }\n  html += '</div>';\n  \n  html += '</div>';\n  \n  return html;\n}\n\nfunction generarGraficoPie(datos) {\n  // Si no hay datos, mostrar mensaje\n  if (!datos || Object.keys(datos).length === 0) {\n    return '<div class=\"alert-info\">No hay datos suficientes para generar el gráfico.</div>';\n  }\n  \n  const labels = Object.keys(datos);\n  const values = Object.values(datos);\n  const total = values.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val, 0);\n  \n  let html = '<div class=\"pie-chart-container\">';\n  \n  // Gráfico de dona\n  html += '<div class=\"pie-chart\">';\n  \n  let startAngle = 0;\n  const colors = ['#06b6d4', '#f59e0b', '#10b981', '#ef4444', '#8b5cf6', '#ec4899'];\n  \n  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {\n    const percentage = (values[i] / total) * 100;\n    const angle = (percentage / 100) * 360;\n    const endAngle = startAngle + angle;\n    \n    if (percentage > 0) {\n      html += `\n        <div class=\"pie-segment\" style=\"\n          --start-angle: ${startAngle}deg;\n          --end-angle: ${endAngle}deg;\n          --color: ${colors[i % colors.length]};\n        \" data-label=\"${labels[i]}\" data-value=\"${values[i]}\" data-percentage=\"${percentage.toFixed(1)}%\">\n        </div>\n      `;\n    }\n    \n    startAngle = endAngle;\n  }\n  \n  html += '</div>';\n  \n  // Leyenda\n  html += '<div class=\"pie-legend\">';\n  for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {\n    const percentage = (values[i] / total) * 100;\n    html += `\n      <div class=\"legend-item\">\n        <span class=\"legend-color\" style=\"background-color: ${colors[i % colors.length]}\"></span>\n        <span class=\"legend-label\">${labels[i]}: ${values[i]} (${percentage.toFixed(1)}%)</span>\n      </div>\n    `;\n  }\n  html += '</div>';\n  \n  html += '</div>';\n  \n  return html;\n}\n\n// Estilos CSS
